# Youth Ka Pakistan (YKP Foundation)

> Youth Ka Pakistan is a nationwide nonprofit in Karachi, Pakistan that educates, empowers, skills, and connects Pakistani youth through free programmes, mentorship, and national events.

- Website: https://youthkapakistan.com/
- Email: info@youthkapakistan.com
- Phone: +92 300 2530110
- Location: Karachi, Sindh, Pakistan
- Also known as: YKP, YKP Foundation, Youth Ka Pakistan

## Leadership
- Patron-in-Chief: Syed Nasir Hussain Shah (YKP events are held under his supervision)
- Chairperson: Ms. Sabi, Youth Ka Pakistan YKP Foundation
- President: Saima Agha, MPA
- Vice President: Azhar Zia Muhammad, YKP Foundation (EMA Group of Companies)

## What the organisation does
Youth Ka Pakistan helps Pakistani youth (boys and girls) build practical skills, find mentors, appear on stage, and access free events. Core pillars: Educate, Empower, Skill, Connect.

## Flagship event
URAAN-E-AI 2026 — Pakistan's Digital Flight. Free national IT and Artificial Intelligence seminar on Tuesday, 1 September 2026 from 2:00 PM at DHA Suffa University, Karachi. RSVP: https://youthkapakistan.com/events
